lines.en: : So, what do you want? Choose any one food item in the store and it’ll be my treat for pretending to help me tonight.
lines.zh: : 那么,你想要什么?店里任何一样吃的,随便挑——就当谢你今晚假装帮我。

lines.en: : Hey, for all you know, I successfully distributed roughly one hundred fliers just now. Who says I was pretending?
lines.zh: : 嘿,你怎么知道我没真的发出去差不多一百张传单?谁说我是在假装?

lines.en: : Only way you could have actually handed off that many bar ads in just a few minutes is if you just conveniently waltzed into the world’s largest AA meeting.
lines.zh: : 几分钟内真能发掉那么多酒吧广告,唯一的可能就是你碰巧晃进了全世界最大的戒酒互助会。

lines.en: : I think that’s the sort of place that’s supposed to make it harder to hand out bar ads.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那种地方,本来就该让酒吧传单更难发才对。

lines.en: : Yeah. You’d think that. Sad truth is that half the people that go to those meetings are ready to jump on the first fuckin’ excuse they can think of to relapse.
lines.zh: : 是。你会这么想。悲伤的真相是,去那种互助会的人,有一半随时准备扑上他们能想到的第一个他妈借口复饮。

lines.en: : Take it from someone who has experience, kid.
lines.zh: : 听听过来人的话吧,小孩。

lines.en: : I don’t know how I feel about being called “kid” when I’m only a few years younger than you.
lines.zh: : 我只比你小几岁,被叫「小孩」,我不知道该作何感想。

lines.en: : Right, right. My b. Just keep seein’ that baby face of yours and thinking you’re only a little older than my daughter.
lines.zh: : 对对。我的错。我就是一直看着你那张婴儿肥的脸,以为你只比我女儿大一点。

lines.en: : My face is not childish and I would greatly appreciate it if you’d take that back.
lines.zh: : 我的脸一点也不幼稚,如果你肯收回这句话,我会不胜感激。

lines.en: : And I’d greatly appreciate it if you’d get a fuckin’ move on and pick your poison already before the people workin’ here think I’m stealin’ shit.
lines.zh: : 我也不胜感激你赶紧挑好你的毒药——免得这里的店员以为我在偷东西。

lines.en: : Are you stealing shit?
lines.zh: : 你在偷东西吗?

lines.en: : What? No. Obviously not.
lines.zh: : 什么?没有。显然没有。

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s obvious if you said yourself that people are going to be assuming that-
lines.zh: : 我觉得这可不算显然——毕竟你自己都说了,别人会以为——

lines.en: : I have a job now, man. I don’t have to steal shit.
lines.zh: : 我现在有工作了,老兄。我不用偷任何东西。

lines.en: : Remember? I pay bills. I’m a normal person. All that gang shit’s a thing of the past as of a little while ago.
lines.zh: : 记得吗?我交账单。我是正常人。那帮帮派破事,刚才那一阵已经全部翻篇了。

lines.en: : You can’t even name all of your bills yet.
lines.zh: : 你连自己的账单都还没数全呢。

lines.en: : Well, forgive me for not fuckin’ memorizing ‘em.
lines.zh: : 嗯,原谅我没他妈把它们背下来。

lines.en: : You have any idea what the longest time I’ve held down an apartment is? Go on. Take a guess.
lines.zh: : 你知道我撑住一间公寓的最长纪录是多久吗?来,猜猜。

lines.en: : I feel like anything I guess here is bound to offend you.
lines.zh: : 我感觉我猜什么都会冒犯你。

lines.en: : Three months.
lines.zh: : 三个月。

lines.en: : In all fairness, it should probably be two. But I’m pretty sure the owner of the place I’m talkin’ about was too scared to remind me that I actually needed to pay.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话,其实应该是两个月。但我相当确定,那处的房东吓得不敢提醒我其实该交租了。

lines.en: : How do you keep finding living arrangements with such a horrible track record as a tenant?
lines.zh: : 以你这样糟糕的租客纪录,你是怎么不断找到住处的?

lines.en: : How do you keep finding preppy girls with perky tits ready to jump your bones despite being twice their age? Just happens. Best not to question any of it.
lines.zh: : 你是怎么不断找到那些胸部坚挺的预备校女孩、让她们顶着你们两倍的岁数扑上你的?就是碰巧。最好什么都别问。

lines.en: : I’m glad to hear you’ve been...paying attention to my students’ chests?
lines.zh: : 我很高兴听说你一直在……注意我学生的胸?

lines.en: : They’re fuckin’ teenagers, man. Their bodies ain’t had time to get all mature and saggy and shit yet. Just safe to assume, you know?
lines.zh: : 她们他妈是青少年,老兄。她们的身体还没来得及变成熟、下垂什么的。先这么假定就对了,懂吧。

lines.en: : At the risk of you hitting me, I’d like to say I wouldn’t go as far as describing you as “mature and saggy.”
lines.zh: : 冒着被你揍的风险,我想说,我还不至于把你描述成「成熟下垂」。

lines.en: : I’d sure fuckin’ hope not.
lines.zh: : 你最好是没有。

lines.en: : Might not be the same as they were back when I was Yumi’s age, but there’s still some life left in these things for now.
lines.zh: : 也许和我 Yumi 那个年纪时不一样了,但这些东西眼下还有点生命。

lines.en: : Maybe cause I’ve been goin’ to the gym?
lines.zh: : 也许因为我开始去健身房了?

lines.en: : I don’t know. What do you think?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。你觉得呢?

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhhh...
: Sup?
lines.zh: : 咋了?

lines.en: : Not...much? I just didn’t expect you of all people to wind up groping yourself in the middle of a convenience store.
lines.zh: : 没……什么?我只是没想到,会是你这种人在便利店中间自我抚摸。

lines.en: : Wanna cop a feel yourself?
lines.zh: : 要不要自己也摸一把?

lines.en: : There is no way this isn’t a trap.
lines.zh: : 这绝对是个陷阱。

lines.en: : Oh, stop. It’s not like I was planning on putting you in an arm lock the second you reached for my chest or anything. That would have just been rude.
lines.zh: : 哦,省省。我又没打算在你刚伸手碰到我胸口的瞬间给你来个锁臂什么的。那样就太没礼貌了。

lines.en: I take a moment to thank my intuition and self control for at least improving in...some sort of way recently.
lines.zh: 我花了一瞬,感谢自己的直觉和自控力最近至少在……某个方面进步了。

lines.en: : Color me surprised, man. You normally don’t waste any time at all when it comes to hittin’ on me for whatever reason.
lines.zh: : 让我吃惊了,老兄。平时不管出于什么理由,你撩我的时候可从不浪费时间。

lines.en: : And here I was actually givin’ you a chance, only for you to pussy out. You’re all talk after all, ain’t ya?
lines.zh: : 而我明明给了你机会,你却怂了。你终究只是嘴上功夫,对吧?

lines.en: : I’m definitely not all talk. You’re just being suspiciously handsy and surprisingly flirty for someone who’s apparently not interested in romance or sex or anything.
lines.zh: : 我绝对不只是嘴上功夫。只是你一个「显然对恋爱、性爱或任何事都不感兴趣」的人,表现得可疑地动手动脚、出奇地爱调情。

lines.en: : Well, apart from keeping me at the top of your secret sex list, I mean.
lines.zh: : 当然,撇开「在您的秘密性爱名单上高居榜首」这一点不谈。

lines.en: : Handsy? The fuck you talkin’ about?
lines.zh: : 动手动脚?你他妈在说什么?

lines.en: : Probably the hand you’re repeatedly tapping me with.
lines.zh: : 多半是你反复拿手戳我的那只手。

lines.en: : That’s just me fuckin’ with you, dude. Just because a girl touches you doesn’t mean she’s tryin’ to sleep with you.
lines.zh: : 那只是我在耍你,哥们。一个女孩碰你,不代表她想和你睡。

lines.en: : Sure. Just like how girls who pick on boys in school by pushing them around on the playground don’t actually have crushes on whoever they’re bullying.
lines.zh: : 行吧。就像学校里在操场上推搡男孩的女孩,其实对被欺负的对象毫无好感一样。

lines.en: : I didn’t, at least. I used to pick on kids just for lookin’ weird and shit.
lines.zh: : 至少我那时候没有。我以前欺负小孩,纯粹因为他们长得怪什么的。

lines.en: Is bullying just a genetic trait for the Yamaguchi family or something?
lines.zh: : 霸凌是山口家的遗传特质吗,还是怎么?

lines.en: Well, I guess Yuki’s maiden name would be something different...but I’m not really in any rush to figure out whatever it was.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我猜 Yuki 出嫁前应该另有其姓……但我并不急着去考证。

lines.en: : There. Do you feel a little safer now that the big, bad ex-biker lady isn’t trying to take your lunch money?
lines.zh: : 好了。凶神恶煞的前机车女不抢你午饭钱了,现在是不是觉得安全多了?

lines.en: : The fact that you were offering to buy me dinner just a minute ago is making this sudden roleplay thing a little harder to follow.
lines.zh: : 你一分钟前还在请我吃晚饭,这让这场突然的角色扮演有点难以跟上。

lines.en: : Still offering. Just waiting for you to fucking pick something instead of waiting for me to keep “flirting” with you.
lines.zh: : 还在请。只是等你他妈的挑一样,而不是等我一直和你「调情」。

lines.en: : But the flirting is so much more fun.
lines.zh: : 可调情有趣多了。

lines.en: : Maybe if it was actual flirting and not just two friends going on a late night sandwich run after work.
lines.zh: : 那得是真调情,而不是两个朋友下班后半夜出门买三明治。

lines.en: : This late night sandwich run is probably the closest you’ve been to being on an actual date literally ever.
lines.zh: : 这场半夜三明治行动,大概已经是你人生中最接近真正约会的一次了。

lines.en: : Yo! That ain’t even remotely-
lines.zh: : 哟!那才不是——

lines.en: : ...true?
lines.zh: : ……真的吗?

lines.en: : You seem confused.
lines.zh: : 你看起来很困惑。

lines.en: : Hold on. I’m tryin’ to think.
lines.zh: : 等等。我在想。

lines.en: : Well, shit. I think you’re right.
lines.zh: : 嗯,见鬼。我觉得你说得对。

lines.en: : I’m sure there were some in the past, but either I was too fucking high to remember ‘em or they just weren’t worth rememberin’ in the first place.
lines.zh: : 过去肯定有过几次,但要么我当时 high 得根本记不住,要么那些事根本不值得记。

lines.en: : So now what? Wanna hold hands or somethin’? Take turns tellin’ each other what we like about each other?
lines.zh: : 那现在呢?要不要牵个手什么的?轮流告诉对方喜欢对方哪一点?

lines.en: : Is the opportunity to grope you still on the table?
lines.zh: : 摸你的机会还作数吗?

lines.en: : Only if you don’t mind gettin’ your dick ripped off the second you try.
lines.zh: : 只要不介意你刚一伸手,那话儿就被扯掉。

lines.en: : Like mother, like daughter, I guess...
lines.zh: : 有其母必有其女,我猜……

lines.en: : Wha-
: Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 哦,糟。

lines.en: : Yumi...
lines.zh: : Yumi……

lines.en: It appears that yet another unfortunate coincidence has befallen me once again.
lines.zh: 看来,又一场不幸的巧合再次降临到我的头上。

lines.en: Well, I suppose it’s not really unfortunate for me. At least not yet.
lines.zh: 嗯,对我而言或许算不上不幸。至少暂时不算。

lines.en: I’m sure the inevitable fallout of this will result in Yumi’s problems finding a way to bring me down in one way or another.
lines.zh: 我确信这件事必然的余波,会让 Yumi 的麻烦以某种方式找上我。

lines.en: But, on the bright side, this might actually be kind of convenient for Yuki if she ever plans on patching things up with her daughter.
lines.zh: 但往好处想,如果 Yuki 哪天打算和女儿重修旧好,这说不定还真有点便利。

lines.en: She just needs to make sure she doesn’t do anything to set her off during what I expect will be an incredibly short conversation.
lines.zh: : 她只需保证,在这场我预计会异常短暂的对话里,不做任何点炸对方的事。

lines.en: Or...maybe not even a conversation at all?
lines.zh: : 又或者……根本算不上对话?

lines.en: : ...I’ll be the one to talk, I guess.
lines.zh: : ……我猜,还是由我开口吧。

lines.en: : Hi, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 嗨,Yumi。

lines.en: : Yeah. Hi.
lines.zh: : 嗯。嗨。

lines.en: : Would you mind explaining what you’re doing all the way in bumfuck nowhere with her?
lines.zh: : 介意解释一下,你为什么会和她跑到这种鸟不拉屎的地方吗?

lines.en: : This is the most populated part of the city and you have weird criteria for what constitutes “bumfuck nowhere.”
lines.zh: : 这是全城人口最稠密的地段,而且你对「鸟不拉屎」的标准很怪。

lines.en: : As for why I’m with her-
lines.zh: : 至于我为什么和她在一起——

lines.en: : We’re on a date.
lines.zh: : 我们在约会。

lines.en: Oh no.
lines.zh: 哦不。

lines.en: : What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你在干什么?

lines.en: : Hm? Flirting, obviously.
lines.zh: : 嗯?调情,显然。

lines.en: : You expect me to believe that you two are on a date?
lines.zh: : 你指望我相信你们俩在约会?

lines.en: : Even this guy, who’s one of the scummiest people I’ve ever met, would have to be drunk out of his fucking mind to even consider going on a “date” with someone like you.
lines.zh: : 连这个家伙——我这辈子见过最下作的人之一——都得喝得他妈烂醉,才会考虑和「你这种货色」约会。

lines.en: : Maybe he just likes girls who are a little rougher around the edges? Don’t ask me, ask him.
lines.zh: : 也许他就是喜欢糙一点的女孩?别问我,问他。

lines.en: : Don’t ask me. We are not on a date and I have no idea why she is doing this.
lines.zh: : 别问我。我们没有在约会,我也不知道她在干什么。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. You could have at least played along a little.
lines.zh: : 哦,拜托。你至少可以配合一下。

lines.en: : I’m already on thin ice with Yumi. The last thing I need is her thinking I’m screwing her mother when I definitely am not.
lines.zh: : 我在 Yumi 面前已经如履薄冰。我最不需要的,就是让她以为我在上她妈——而我绝对没有。

lines.en: : Great. Consider yourself lucky then for not catching one of the millions of STDs the world’s greatest mom over here is carrying.
lines.zh: : 太好了。那你真该庆幸,没染上这位「全球最伟大母亲」随身携带的几百种性病里的一种。

lines.en: : Okay, Yuki was clearly in the wrong with pretending to date me, but-
lines.zh: : 好,假装和我约会显然是 Yuki 不对,但是——

lines.en: : Nah, she’s right. Well, apart from the STD thing. I deserve whatever she throws at me.
lines.zh: : 不,她说得对。撇开性病那部分。她扔给我什么,我都受着。

lines.en: : Besides, this is the first time she’s said anything to me in years. I’ll take what I can get.
lines.zh: : 再说,这是她这么多年来第一次跟我说话。能捞多少是多少。

lines.en: : What you can get is the fuck away from my teacher who, coincidentally, also happens to be dating my best fucking friend.
lines.zh: : 你能捞的是离我的老师远一点——而那位老师,碰巧还是我最好的朋友的男朋友。

lines.en: : Wait, you never told me that.
lines.zh: : 等等,你没跟我说过这个。

lines.en: : I thought you were fucking Yumi?
lines.zh: : 我以为在和你上床的是 Yumi?

lines.en: : What you can get is the fuck away from my teacher, you dumb bitch.
lines.zh: : 你能捞的是离我的老师远一点,你这个蠢货。

lines.en: : Just your teacher?
lines.zh: : 只是老师?

lines.en: : Yuki, no.
lines.zh: : Yuki,别。

lines.en: : Well, what else would he fucking be?
lines.zh: : 嗯,不然他他妈还能是什么?

lines.en: : Beats me. I just thought you two were screwing or something.
lines.zh: : 天知道。我只是以为你们俩在乱搞什么的。

lines.en: : You thought fucking what?
lines.zh: : 你以为我在和谁乱搞?

lines.en: : Well...yeah. Because I’ve seen you two around together and...I don’t know. I just kinda figured there was some shit goin’ on.
lines.zh: : 嗯……对。因为我见过你们俩一起出现,而且……我不知道。我就是觉得有点什么事。

lines.en: : Sensei always told me that wasn’t the case, but I kinda just figured that was because I’m your mom and that would make shit real awkward for him.
lines.zh: : Sensei 一直告诉我不是那样,但我差不多认定,那只是因为我是你妈——真说破了,他会非常尴尬。

lines.en: : Are you fucking kidding me?
lines.zh: : 你他妈在开玩笑吗?

lines.en: : What? It’s a misunderstanding. It’s not a big deal.
lines.zh: : 怎么?这是个误会。又不是什么大事。

lines.en: : But, uhh...apart from that...
lines.zh: : 不过,呃……撇开这个……

lines.en: : You...got taller?
lines.zh: : 你……长高了?

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s a little known fact, but most kids continue growing once their parents walk out on them.
lines.zh: : 对。这是个冷知识:大部分小孩,在父母抛弃他们之后还会继续长个。

lines.en: : Okay, I’m just...gonna...go over there.
lines.zh: : 好,我只是……要去……那边。

lines.en: Yuki lets go of my collar and I quickly make my way over to the magazine rack to make it look like I’m...doing anything but being involved in this discussion.
lines.zh: Yuki 松开我的衣领,我迅速走到杂志架前,假装自己……正在做任何与这场讨论无关的事。

lines.en: And while I’d like to say it will only be a matter of time until one of the staff breaks things up (Which probably should be my job), it looks like the only person working really doesn’t want to get involved.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很想说,店员迟早会来劝架(那本来多半该是我的职责),但看起来唯一在班的店员,完全不想掺和。

lines.en: And I don’t blame them. Neither Yuki nor Yumi look particularly friendly...especially when they’re at each other’s throats.
lines.zh: : 而我怪不了她。Yuki 和 Yumi 看起来都不怎么友善……尤其是她们互相掐住对方喉咙的时候。
